title: Compression apparatus with cylindrical specimen
visual_facts: A short cylindrical concrete-like specimen marked A3028 is positioned vertically in a test apparatus.
A broad flat metal platen presses down on the top of the specimen.
The specimen stands on a dark circular base beneath the platen.
Two polished vertical columns flank the apparatus.
Fragments of material are scattered across the base and surrounding surface.
A blue control panel with a display is visible at the lower left.
spatial_relations: The specimen is centered on the base between the vertical columns and beneath the upper platen.
uncertainties: The test procedure and measured results are not shown.
Small text on the control panel is unreadable.
